title: Anomaly Realization in Charge-Flux Detector Correlators
summary: Quantum anomalies provide a bridge between ultraviolet properties of a theory and its infrared sector. We study how this connection appears in axial-charge-flow observables. In the simplest example, an axial-charge detector probes the fermionic cut of the anomalous triangle and resolves its infrared content as an angular distribution. The massless limit does not commute with the angular integration: a contribution suppressed at fixed angle collapses onto the two beam-collinear directions while retaining the finite integrated sum rule fixed by the axial anomaly.
